blocks.text: Igor Klushin advises on EU, UK, US and Swiss sanctions regimes, including risk assessment, due diligence and policy design. He also represents clients in liaising with sanctions authorities and assists with challenging sanctions listings in administrative and court proceedings.

runs.text: Igor Klushin advises on EU, UK, US and Swiss sanctions regimes, including risk assessment, due diligence and policy design. He also represents clients in liaising with sanctions authorities and assists with challenging sanctions listings in administrative and court proceedings.

blocks.text: In addition to his work on sanctions law, Igor focuses on international arbitration and complex cross-border disputes. He represents clients in international arbitrations under a variety of arbitration rules, including those of the Arbitration Institute of the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce, the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre and the International Chamber of Commerce. He has extensive experience of dealing with corporate and shareholder disputes, bankruptcy-related disputes and cross-border recognition and the enforcement of arbitral awards and court judgments.
